overview: Sketchora is a professional Web3 drawing app on Arc Testnet featuring a premium notification system, smooth transaction UX, and a fully redesigned user guide — making Web3 drawing feel effortless and next-gen.
features: Global toast notification system with glassmorphism + neon glow
Smart notifications for wallet, transactions, network, and actions
Persistent transaction processing UI with animated loader
Arc Testnet branding badge and premium visual enhancements
Micro-interactions: button glow, click bounce, smooth transitions
Prevent duplicate transaction clicks with UI lock
